title: Adaptive Triage Replayer and Staged Evidence Scorer
author: Priya Kumar
description: Problem: On-call handoffs and post-incident triage routinely require re-running slices of telemetry and attachments to reconstruct the state that triggered alerts. Existing replay tooling either replays too little context (misses correlated signals) or replays everything (expensive, privacy-risky). Motivation: provide a compact, privacy-aware, configurable replayer that can stage evidence by confidence and freshness and a lightweight heuristic scorer to surface the most actionable evidence for responders. This PR introduces two coordinated features: (1) an adaptive triage replayer CLI/service that replays telemetry windows with deterministic sampling and staged output tiers (hot/warm/cold), and (2) a staged evidence scorer that ranks replayed artifacts using freshness, responder-latency proxies, signal entropy, and provenance quality. Key design points: deterministic sampling ensures replays are reproducible across runs; staged tiers let responders fetch hot tier synchronously and pull warm/cold tiers lazily; a privacy sanitizer strips PII from attachments and replaces sensitive fields with deterministic tokens so locally reproducible diffs are possible; scoring is rule-based with pluggable weights and a simple ML calibration hook for future work. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (linear/ENG-6483) [x] CLI + API surface implemented [x] unit & integration tests added [x] privacy sanitizer included with config toggle [x] docs and examples updated [x] migration notes and rollout plan prepared Rollout plan: feature is behind a feature flag (triage.replay.v2). Default behaviour unchanged. Staged rollout to internal SRE then limited customer alpha. Monitoring: add metrics triage.replay.requests, triage.replay.latency_p50/p95, evidence.scorer.score_distribution, privacy.sanitizer.rate. How to test locally: use the included sample bundle (tools/replay/sample-bundle.tar.gz), run `tools/replay/cli --bundle sample-bundle.tar.gz --window 00:05:00 --mode staged`, validate hot tier returns within 500ms in local mode. Security considerations: privacy sanitizer is opt-in by default for replay across account boundaries; local replays retain full fidelity. See SUP-4821 for compliance questions. Related work: builds on incident-bot replaying primitives (incident-bot/handlers/replay) and extends the slo-toolkit playback harness (slo-toolkit/playback). Notes: this is a medium-risk infra change because of new long-running replay workers; autoscaling rules were added to avoid resource exhaustion.

review_comments: Ethan Chen: Overall this looks solid. A couple of requests: (1) please add a guard in the worker for very large bundles so we fail fast instead of OOMing; (2) expand the scorer doc to show example score ranges and how weights interact.
Priya Kumar (author): Added bundle-size guard (config triage.replay.max_bundle_mb) and expanded scorer docs with examples. See commit d4f9a90 and docs update.
Marisol Vega: Can we reduce the default warm-tier retention to 24h instead of 72h for the first rollout? That will limit storage blowup while we observe access patterns.
Priya Kumar (author): Agreed; changed default in helm values and documented the rationale in rollout notes.
Devon Park: integration tests looked flaky on CI due to timing assumptions in the sampler; recommend switching to clock-mocking for tests.
Priya Kumar (author): Switched tests to frozen time fixture and added retries in the replay e2e harness. The flake was resolved in f1a2b6c.
release_notes: Add adaptive triage replay and staged evidence scoring: reusable CLI/service for deterministic, staged telemetry replay; privacy sanitizer for cross-account replays; heuristic evidence scorer to surface hot artifacts. Feature gated behind triage.replay.v2. See docs/triage/replay.md for usage and rollout instructions.
migration_notes: Feature gated; no automatic migration required. Operators should set triage.replay.max_bundle_mb and warm_tier_retention before enabling for production. Helm values example included in deploy/helm/values.replay.yaml.
testing_instructions: Local: tools/replay/cli --bundle sample-bundle.tar.gz --window 00:05:00 --mode staged. CI runs included mocked clock fixtures. Manual: run small alpha against internal SRE project and sample bundles before wider rollout.
monitoring_and_alerting: New metrics: triage.replay.requests, triage.replay.latency_p50, triage.replay.latency_p95, evidence.scorer.score_distribution. Alert: triage.replay.error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m and avg hot-tier latency > 1s.
notes: Performance: initial perf bench showed p50 hot-tier latency increase of ~5% under a synthetic load; added autoscaling policy in deploy/helm to add worker replicas under burst load. Privacy: cross-account replay remains opt-in with sanitizer enabled by default for external replays.
